notes: All source videos downloaded at 360p (YouTube served format 18 via the android player client; the default client returned HTTP 403). quote is empty throughout: audio was not reviewed, the montage is silent. Every clip was checked in contact sheets, a zoom sheet, a per-clip frame row and a proof frame at start+1 s.
